scope: Advanced Collaboration — Full-Stack Integration (10 gaps, HIGH/MEDIUM complexity)

tasks.title: LLM cross-provider automatic fallback chain
tasks.description: Create LLMFallbackChain service wrapping existing CircuitBreakerRegistry and LLMServiceImpl. Add configurable primary→secondary→tertiary provider chain with retry policy per tier. Add latency-aware provider selection (track per-provider response times). Publish fallback events via IEventBus. Integrate with existing LLMServiceImpl.getProvider() flow — when circuit is open, automatically try next provider in chain. No changes to existing getProvider() signature.
tasks.convergence: LLM calls automatically fallback to next provider on circuit open; latency tracking influences provider selection

tasks.title: Event bus replay + dead-letter queue
tasks.description: Extend TypedEventBus with: (1) EventLog — append-only ring buffer storing published events with configurable retention; (2) DeadLetterQueue — captures events whose handlers throw, stores event+error+handler metadata, provides retry API with exponential backoff; (3) EventReplay — replay events from a given timestamp/sequence number, with optional channel filter; (4) Backpressure — when subscriber queue exceeds threshold, apply configurable strategy (buffer/sample/drop-oldest). All features opt-in via EventBusConfig — existing synchronous dispatch behavior unchanged when not configured.
tasks.convergence: EventBus supports persistence, replay, dead-letter capture, and backpressure; zero impact when not configured

tasks.title: Delegate parallel result aggregation
tasks.description: Create ParallelResultAggregator service with configurable strategies: merge-all (default), first-N, majority-vote, schema-validated. Add timeout coordination for parallel sub-plans — configurable per-sub-task timeout with partial result collection on timeout. Add typed result contracts via generics replacing unknown. Integrate with SubPlanDispatcher — add aggregateWith() method accepting strategy. Publish aggregation events via IEventBus.
tasks.convergence: Parallel sub-plan results aggregated with configurable strategy; timeout coordination; typed results

tasks.title: Obsidian ↔ Knowledge bidirectional real-time sync
tasks.description: Create ObsidianKnowledgeSync service: (1) Vault → Knowledge: watch Obsidian vault for file changes (create/modify/delete), parse frontmatter+content, sync entities/relations to IKnowledgeService; (2) Knowledge → Vault: subscribe to IEventBus knowledge:entity-updated/created/deleted events, write corresponding .md files to vault; (3) Conflict resolution: configurable strategy (last-write-wins, merge, human-queue); (4) Debounced batch sync for performance. Leverages existing IObsidianService, IKnowledgeService, and IEventBus.
tasks.convergence: Obsidian vault and Knowledge store sync bidirectionally in real-time with conflict resolution

tasks.title: MCP Gateway service discovery + health monitoring
tasks.description: Create MCPServiceDiscovery: config-driven provider discovery (reads mcp-config.json or environment), auto-registers discovered providers with MCPRequestRouter. Create MCPHealthMonitor: periodic background health probes (configurable interval), updates provider health status in MCPRequestRouter, publishes health change events via IEventBus, triggers circuit breaker transitions on health degradation. Service lifecycle: hot-add/remove providers without restart, health-based auto-disable with recovery detection.
tasks.convergence: MCP Gateway discovers providers dynamically and monitors health continuously

tasks.title: Search relevance scoring + cache invalidation
tasks.description: Create SearchRelevanceScorer: configurable scoring beyond RRF — recency boost, source authority weight, query expansion scoring. Track selection signals for learning. Create SearchCacheManager: LRU cache with TTL for search results, event-driven invalidation (subscribe to knowledge:entity-updated, obsidian:file-changed via IEventBus), cross-backend coherence (knowledge change invalidates related vector/graph cache entries). Warmup for common queries.
tasks.convergence: Search results scored with relevance signals; cache invalidated on source data changes

tasks.title: Quality gate feedback loop
tasks.description: Create QualityGateFeedbackLoop: (1) GapDetector reads verification.json gaps and maps them to plan tasks; (2) RemediationPlanner converts gaps into concrete re-execution sub-plans; (3) FeedbackOrchestrator coordinates: detect gap → generate remediation plan → execute fix via SubPlanDispatcher → re-verify → track iteration count; (4) Escalation policy: after max retries, escalate to human review with full gap context. Publish feedback loop events via IEventBus. Integration with ArtifactContract for gap artifact passing.
tasks.convergence: Verification gaps automatically trigger remediation planning and re-execution with escalation after max retries

tasks.title: Graph ↔ Wiki link resolution bridge
tasks.description: Create GraphWikiLinkBridge: (1) resolveGraphToWiki — given graph entity ID, find corresponding wiki page path; (2) resolveWikiToGraph — given wiki [[link]], find corresponding graph entity; (3) maintain bidirectional link index; (4) orphaned link detection — wiki links with no graph node, graph edges with no wiki page; (5) Link integrity check — scan for broken/dangling links. Integration with IGraphEngine for traversal and IObsidianService for page resolution.
tasks.convergence: Graph entities and wiki pages resolvable bidirectionally with integrity checking

tasks.title: Workflow engine parallel wave execution
tasks.description: Create WaveExecutionEngine: (1) read plan.json waves with task arrays; (2) execute all tasks within a wave concurrently using SubPlanDispatcher; (3) wait for wave completion before advancing; (4) wave-level failure handling (retry-all/retry-failed/skip/abort); (5) wave lifecycle events via IEventBus; (6) wave-level budget guardrails. Integration with existing WorkflowEngine — add wave execution mode as opt-in via plan config. Preserve sequential execution as default.
tasks.convergence: Workflow engine executes plan waves in parallel with wave-level coordination and failure handling

tasks.title: Full-stack integration test suite
tasks.description: Integration test suite covering: (1) LLM fallback chain with circuit breaker — simulate provider failure, verify automatic fallback, verify circuit recovery; (2) Search pipeline with cache — execute search, modify knowledge, verify cache invalidation, verify fresh results; (3) Workflow artifact contracts — run analyze→plan→execute, verify artifact passing between stages; (4) EventBus replay + DLQ — publish events, kill handler, verify DLQ capture, replay events; (5) MCP Gateway health monitoring — register provider, simulate health degradation, verify auto-disable; (6) Obsidian↔Knowledge sync — modify vault file, verify knowledge update; modify knowledge, verify vault update; (7) Graph↔Wiki bridge — create graph entity, verify wiki page resolvable; create wiki link, verify graph edge; (8) Quality gate feedback loop — inject verification gap, verify remediation plan generated; (9) Wave execution — execute 2-wave plan, verify parallel execution within wave, sequential between waves. Target: >= 80% integration coverage.
tasks.convergence: All 9 integration test suites passing; >= 80% coverage of cross-service workflows
